semantics: After genuine delivery acknowledgment hide delivered MQ01 objective20; preserve old delivery/reward/removal/50 and caravan Debrief. New offer replaces immediate road-handoff page when bindings are complete; stage60/100 retains its old debrief completion meaning.

Initial offer follows debrief. Later Pritchard activations prioritize pending inquiry. When existing side Report is available, SayInquirySheriffMenu keeps Report at index1; no defer or invalid answer activates a road.

OfferDead only if the authoritative current Alias_Marshal has a dead actor; otherwise Offer uses neutral source-unknown wording. Never read a prologue promise or claim the wreck caused death. No mandatory prologue binding.

Ada's new menu offers the local purchase question or the literal old Ada branch. History acknowledgment records only the attributed account, not SQ10/14, evidence level, custody, sabotage or any outcome.

State is persisted on Act1Walk. A captured original actor/player/local context and epoch own each new page; publish ownership before true player-load registration. Revalidate after each yielding call/page before acceptance/fact/report or journal effects. Actual saved load invalidates the pending answer and restores earned markers only; death/context failure invalidates the owned transaction without changing earned facts.

Missing/dead/disabled/unloaded required actor is explicitly unresolved, not automatic completion. Keep earned state; hide impossible dead/missing targets when reconciling, do not fabricate speech. Marker/start failures do not invent acceptance or report success.

New pages are unvoiced. End owned inquiry listener before delegating to old Report, old Ada Book audio or explicit old road action, preserving their existing ownership. No old prerecorded caption is rewritten.

No new quest stages, reward, inventory, relationship, forced travel or global framework; local journal alone starts/completes. Missing new bindings use honest existing behavior rather than a fake new task.

messages.text: Pritchard: Thank you for bringing the dispatch. I need facts before I tell Mercy what happened. Ask Ada Pike when the railway last bought brake shoes, then bring me her account.
Pritchard: Tobias is dead. I'm sorry to hear it. I need facts before I tell Mercy what happened. Ask Ada Pike when the railway last bought brake shoes, then bring me her account.
Pritchard: Do you want to follow up on Ada's brake-repair account, or talk about the railway ledger?
Pritchard: Ada keeps the railway's repair books. Ask her when they last bought brake shoes, then come back to me. I want her account before I draw a conclusion.
Ada: Are you asking about the railway's brake-shoe purchases, or is there something else you need?
Ada: The railway used to buy brake shoes every season. It hasn't taken a pair since spring. That's what I can tell you about its purchases; it doesn't tell me what happened to that carriage.
buttons: I'll tell Pritchard what you said.

messages.text:
You: Ada says the railway used to buy brake shoes every season. She says it hasn't taken a pair since spring.

Pritchard: That's an account worth checking. It doesn't settle what caused the wreck.
Pritchard: I'll check the railway's records against her account. When you're ready, we can talk about the roads out of Mercy.
The inquiry is still unresolved. One of the people you need is unavailable. Any account you've already heard is kept; this does not complete the report.
